features.label: Smart clamp system
features.text: Integrated smart clamp allows for easy one-handed donning and doffing while maintaining the precise position of the ankle cuff for consistent support.

features.label: Dual attachment options
features.text: Includes both a transparent plastic inlay for use between shoelaces and a nut and bolt kit for direct eyelet attachment to customize your support method.

features.label: Adjustable dynamic support
features.text: Elastic strap provides adjustable dorsiflexion support with options for medial or lateral positioning to correct specific gait deviations.

features.label: Breathable contoured design
features.text: Lightweight, breathable materials are contoured to the shape of the leg for all-day comfort and long-term wearability during daily activities.

features.label: Pdac approved l1930
features.text: Verified ankle foot orthosis designed for dorsiflexion support, prefabricated and adjustable for a custom fit.

measurement: Ankle Cuff: Measure ankle circumference around the malleoli (bony part of the ankle). S/M fits 7 - 8.5 in. LG/XL fits 10 - 13 in. Foot Wrap: Measure foot circumference behind the ball of the foot. OSFM fits 8 - 11 in. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
